title: Fried Ravioli
description: Fried Ravioli is a Continental / Italian-inspired fine dining dish featuring breaded and deep-fried ravioli with an elegant garnish, served with roasted tomato coulis or truffle aioli.

ingredients.title: For the Ravioli (fresh pasta dough)
items: 250 g Tipo "00" flour (or all-purpose flour, sifted)

ingredients.title: Filling (classic ricotta & spinach)
items: 100 g blanched spinach, finely chopped & squeezed dry
Salt & cracked black pepper, to taste

ingredients.title: For Coating & Frying
items: 2 large eggs, beaten with 1 tbsp milk
50 g fine Italian breadcrumbs (for texture balance)
1 tsp dried oregano or thyme (optional, mixed into breadcrumbs)
Sunflower oil or light olive oil (for frying, 170–175°C)

ingredients.title: Garnishes & Accompaniments
items: Truffle aioli or roasted tomato coulis (for dipping/sauce)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare Pasta Dough
steps: Make a well in the flour, add eggs, yolk, olive oil, and salt.
Knead until smooth (10 minutes), wrap in cling film, and rest 30 minutes.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare Filling
steps: Mix ricotta, chopped spinach, Parmesan, garlic, nutmeg, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning—must be flavorful but balanced.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble Ravioli
steps: Roll dough thin (1 mm) using a pasta machine.
Pipe or spoon filling onto one sheet, cover with another, press edges to seal.
Cut into ravioli shapes (square or round). Chill 10 minutes to firm up.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Breading
steps: Dredge each raviolo in seasoned flour → egg wash → breadcrumb mix.
Rest on a tray for 15 minutes to set coating.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Frying
steps: Fry in small batches until golden brown (about 2 minutes each).
Drain on paper towels, season lightly with sea salt.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Plating (Restaurant Style)
steps: Swipe or pool tomato coulis / truffle aioli on plate.
Arrange 3–4 ravioli per portion, slightly stacked.
Garnish with micro basil, shaved Parmesan, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with roasted tomato coulis or truffle aioli.
Serve as a fine dining starter with 3–5 ravioli per portion.

chefTips: Crisp-Coating Balance: Mix panko with fine breadcrumbs for a refined crunch, not overly rustic.
Sauce Pairing: A roasted tomato coulis brings acidity; truffle aioli adds luxury. Choose depending on menu style.
Portioning: Fine dining plating usually features 3–5 ravioli as a starter, not a heavy serving.
Wine Pairing: A crisp Pinot Grigio or sparkling Prosecco complements beautifully.
